title: What is a half?
keyIdea: A half is one of two equal parts.

kid: Cut a cake into two parts that are the same size. Each part is a half.
If one part is big and one is small, they are not halves.
adult: A half is one of two equal parts of a whole shape or a group. The key word is equal: two unequal pieces are not halves.
Children meet halves first with shapes and food, then with groups: half of 8 sweets is 4, because 8 shared fairly between two is 4 each.

familyTip: Fold a piece of paper in half. Check the two parts match exactly. Then share 6 grapes into two fair halves.

practice.prompt: A pizza is cut into 2 equal parts. Each part is…
practice.explain: Two equal parts: each is a half.

practice.prompt: A cake is cut into one big part and one small part. Are they halves?
choices: No, they are not the same size
practice.explain: Halves are equal, so these are not halves.

practice.prompt: Half of the {=2*n} cars are red. How many are red?

pool.prompt: How many halves make a whole?
Sam eats half of {=2*n} grapes. How many does Sam eat?

choices: A square cut into 2 same-size parts, one shaded
A square cut into 3 parts, one shaded
A square cut into 2 different parts, one shaded
pool.explain: Only the first has two equal parts.

pool.prompt: Half an apple and half an apple make…
Is half of 10 the same as 5?
A sandwich is cut into 2 equal parts. You eat 1. What did you eat?
pool.explain: One of two equal parts is a half.

visual.caption: Tap the parts. Shade one of the two equal parts: that is a half.
